_comment: Numeric series for the main-page visualisations. Inline this into the page as a JS object; do not fetch it at runtime. All values are exact as measured — do not round.

experiment_matrix._note: status drives cell colour: valid | unexplained | invalid

arms.label: vanilla
arms.reason: Healthy to epoch 200, then degrades — see failure mode 3

arms.label: rp
arms.reason: Only accuracy gain, but +2.27 pp is 0.59σ against seed noise — dissolves

arms.label: rppp
arms.reason: Positional shortcut — encoder collapses to a position lookup within 26 epochs of the auxiliary activating

arms.label: uc
arms.reason: 40–60% of prediction targets leaked to the encoder; also never evaluated due to a path bug

arms.label: hc
arms.reason: Same leak; and the hardness score is a fixed spatial prior, identical for every image

arms.label: mtuc
arms.reason: Both failure modes; also never evaluated

baseline_signature._caption: CIFAR-10 vanilla. Position readout falls while effective rank rises — the signature of healthy training.

positional_shortcut._caption: Token-level effective rank. The auxiliary objective activates at epoch 40.

mask_leak._caption: Measured over 45,600 per-image samples. Vanilla's overlap is exactly zero.
mask_leak._note: Render as a 16x16 grid for CIFAR. Use the counts to place context / target / overlap cells; exact positions are arbitrary, the proportions are the point.

uniform_law._note: Expected leak = num_keep x |targets| / N. Four for four, within 0.1 of a patch.

freeze_test._caption: Linear probe accuracy vs epoch, CIFAR-10. Frozen runs go flat and stay flat.

seed_variance._caption: Three genuine seeds of the baseline. Seed 2 shows essentially no decline.

ema_survivor._caption: EMA momentum held constant at 0.999 from epoch 0. Single run, unreplicated.
ema_survivor._reference: Deltas are against the three-seed baseline means (seed_variance.peak_mean, seed_variance.ep400_mean), the same reference as the sigma values.

labelfree_metrics._caption: Mean absolute error, in epochs, between each metric's peak and the linear probe's peak.

heldout_loss._caption: van_baseline, CIFAR-10. Both fall from ep200; the absolute gap widens to ep300 then plateaus near 0.015 while the relative gap grows from 2.4% to 10.7%.

proven: The diagnostic instrument, with a passing positive control
The positional shortcut — causal, both datasets, within-run before/after contrast
Mask leakage — an exact quantitative law over 45,600 measurements
The optimiser drives the post-peak decline — freeze test, −0.01 pp
Four alternative explanations for that decline, each eliminated by measurement
Label-free metrics miss the peak by roughly 100 epochs
RotNet-only is 8.82 pp below I-JEPA+RP across three seeds
Per-patch prediction error is heteroscedastic and content-driven, not positional
not_proven: Any accuracy improvement from the original UARPT design
Rotation prediction's advantage — 0.59σ, inside seed noise
That the late-training decline is universal — one of three seeds is flat
The EMA result — n = 1, no replication
That any of this transfers to STL-10 at matched settings — the STL baseline run is invalid
That removing the positional shortcut rescues the auxiliary objective
Anything at ImageNet scale — entirely untested
abandoned: The curriculum as originally designed — target-side percentile selection; never ran
Uncertainty-weighted latent prediction (β-NLL) — gate measured and open, method never built
The adversarial fix for the positional shortcut — designed, never implemented
Predictor capacity — 1:1 width where the reference has a 3.3× bottleneck; never swept
Mask geometry — ImageNet defaults never re-tuned for a 16×16 grid of 2×2-pixel patches
Anti-collapse regularisation — LeJEPA / SIGReg is the obvious baseline; never run
